buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 3. Generic Manufacturer Authorization:Wherever Authorised Distributors/service providers are submitting the bid, Authorisation Form /Certificate with OEM/Original Service Provider details such as name, designation, address, e-mail Id and Phone No. required to be furnished along with the bid

4. Generic Without prejudice to Buyer’s right to price adjustment by way of discount or any other right or remedy available to Buyer, Buyer may terminate the Contract or any part thereof by a written notice to the Seller, if: i) The Seller fails to comply with any material term of the Contract. ii) The Seller informs Buyer of its inability to deliver the Material(s) or any part thereof within the stipulated Delivery Period or such inability otherwise becomes apparent. iii) The Seller fails to deliver the Material(s) or any part thereof within the stipulated Delivery Period and/or to replace/rectify any rejected or defective Material(s) promptly. iv) The Seller becomes bankrupt or goes into liquidation. v) The Seller makes a general assignment for the benefit of creditors. vi) A receiver is appointed for any substantial property owned by the Seller. vii) The Seller has misrepresented to Buyer, acting on which misrepresentation Buyer has placed the Purchase Order on the Seller. 5. Generic While generating invoice in GeM portal, the seller must upload scanned copy of GST invoice and the screenshot of GST portal confirming payment of GST. 6. Sample Clause After award of contract – Successful Bidder shall have to get advance sample approved from buyer before bulk manufacturing / starting bulk supplies. Successful Bidder shall submit 3 samples for Buyer's approval, within 15 days of award of contract. Buyer shall, as per contract specifications framework, either approve the advance sample or will provide complete list of modification required in the sample within 7 days of receipt of advance sample. Seller shall be required to ensure supply as per approved sample with modifications as communicated by Buyer. If there is delay from buyer side in approval of advance sample – the delivery period shall be refixed without LD for the period of delay in sample approval. In case, the sample is found to have major deviations / not conforming to the Contract specifications, the buyer at its discretion may call for fresh samples for approval before allowing bulk supplies or may terminate the contract after notifying the deviations to the seller. Unless otherwise provided in the contract, all samples required for test shall be supplied by the contractor free of cost. Where under the contract, the contractor is required to submit an advance sample, any expenses incurred by the contractor on or in connection with the production of stores in bulk, before the sample has been approved unconditionally shall be borne by the Seller and he shall not claim any compensation in the event of such sample being found unacceptable by the Buyer / Consignee. 7. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Only supply of Goods 8. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 9. Certificates ISO 9001: The bidder or the OEM of the offered products must have ISO 9001 certification. 10. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ADDITIONAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS (ATC) FOR PROCUREMENT OF "S UITCASE WITH TROLLEY" 1. Lab Test Reports: The latest lab test report confirming the product specific

ations as per DG CRPF, Dte, vide letter no. U-II-98(Spec)/2023-24-Prov-(Suitcase )-14 Dated 01/11/2023, shall be submitted from a designated testing agency/lab (i.e., CIPET / MSME Mumbai / NTH / MSME Meerut). The test report m ust be dated after the official publication/floating date of the BID. 2. Compliance with Specification: Participating firms must explicitly submit the details of the specific model being offered. 3. Product Catalogue: Firms must offer and upload the official product catalo gue along with their standard Bid documents. 4. Mandatory In-House Manufacturing & Testing Facilities: The Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) must possess complete, functional in-house ma nufacturing and testing facilities required for the production of the suitcases. Ou tsourced or partially outsourced manufacturing processes shall not be permitte d under any circumstances. 5. Production Capacity Certification / Vendor Assessment Certificate: It is mandatory to submit the OEM’s Production Capability Certificate or Vendor As sessment Certificate for the specific bid item, issued by designated agencies (CI PET / MSME Meerut / MSME Mumbai / NTH). The following machines and testing equipment must be mandatorily available in the OEM's own physical manufacturing plant: a. Injection Moulding Machine (for injecting Polypropylene) with a minimu m capacity of 900 tons. Capacity verification documents must be provide d showing the machine can mould large-size luggage shells at 900 tons or more. b. Multi-layer sheet extrusion machine. c. CNC trimming machine. d. Complete assembly line setup (including 869 stitching machines, high l ead machines, etc.). e. Wheel testing machine. f. Jerk testing machine. g. Tumble testing machine. h. Drop test machine. i. Zipper testing machine. j. Trolley testing machine. The firm must also provide the capacity verification report/certificate issued by CIPET/MSME/NTH along with the bid, alongside test certificates, undertakings, a nd raw material invoices for Virgin Polypropylene to track batch quality. Comple te documentation confirming 100% inspection of luggage at the end of the asse mbly line must be supplied. 6. Factory License: Firms must submit a valid OEM Factory License issued by the respective State Government. 7. Pollution Control Certificate: Firms must submit a valid OEM Pollution Co

ntrol Certificate issued by the respective State Pollution Control Board. 8. Compliance with Quality and Environmental Standards: The OEM must comply with the following international regulatory systems, and valid certificate s must be uploaded with the bid: A. ISO 9001:2015 (Quality Management System) B. ISO 14001:2015 (Environmental Management System) 9. Anti-Theft Zipper: A certified test report of the anti-theft zipper feature wit h a relevant test certificate must be uploaded. 10. Quality Assurance: (a) Manufacturers/Contractors must satisfy themselves first by carrying ou t a thorough pre-inspection of each lot/batch to ensure the stores conform to contractual specifications before offering them for Pre-Dispatch Inspecti on (PDI). A Certificate of Conformity for raw materials from the respective OEM or CIPET/MSME/NTH must be provided. (b) A formal declaration by the Contractor must be enclosed stating that n ecessary pre-inspection tests have been executed and the stores are comp letely fit for inspection. 11. Marking & Branding: Internal Branding: The CRPF Logo must be marked using indelible ink on the fabric on the inner side of the suitcase. Taffeta Label: A Taffeta Label must be securely stitched at one corner of the inner side seams using indelible ink or embroidery containing: Marking compliant with the latest IS standards (IS 15809:2017) Month and Year of manufacture Manufacturer's name, trade name, or registered trademark Washing, drying, and usage care instructions (Note: Pictograms are st rictly prohibited; text instructions must be written out). 12. Packing Specifications: The following material standards shall be used fo r packing the suitcase with trolley: Transparent polybag wrapping of minimum 50-micron thickness. A 3-ply separator flap placed between suitcases to avoid surface scratches during transit. Heavy-duty 5-ply cartons for the multiple-packing outer boxes. Printed adhesive tape of minimum 60 mm width for secure box packing. 13. Method of Packing: The suitcases shall be delivered and packed in a bran d-new, dry, clean, and sound condition. Two suitcases, each separately wrappe d in individual non-woven bags, shall form one (1) Unit Pack (carton). This carto n shall be wrapped in an HDPE bag, securely machine-stitched with at least 6 stitches per 10 cm, and bound with polypropylene strapping (two bands across t he width, one band across the length). Straps must be single continuous pieces and heat-sealed by machine. 14. Marking of Package: Before dispatch, each shipping package must be leg ibly and indelibly printed in black with the following details: (a) Nomenclature and Catalog Number of the store. (b) Total quantity packed in the bale/carton.

(c) Lot Number and production date. (d) Month and year of packing. (e) Name and registered trademark of the manufacturer. (f) Gross mass of the package/bale in kilograms. (g) Supply Order (S.O.) / Extract Number and date. (h) Inspection Note Number and date. (j) Unique Serial Number of the package. (k) Name and full address of the receiving consignee. 15. Joint PDI (Pre-Dispatch Inspection): Joint PDI shall be conducted by the designated Board of Officers (BOO) from this office alongside an a uthorized representative from CIPET / MSME Meerut / MSME Mumbai / NTH. All expenses, charges, and testing fees associated with the Joint PDI and lab testing shall be entirely borne by the seller. The buyer sha ll not incur any financial liability on account of these inspections. 16. Past Performance: The OEM should have supplied same or similar item o f bid product 30% of bid quantity (i.e , in at least one of the Financial years 202 3-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26 before the bid opening date to any Central / State Gov t Organization / PSU. Copies of relevant contracts alongwith CRAC (proving supp ly of cumulative order quantity in any one financial year) to be submitted along with bid in support of quantity supplied in the relevant Financial year. Bidders a re required to submit, Contract Copy, CRAC, Inspection note etc. in support of P ast performance clause mentioned in bid document. Note:- Bidder must possess past performance records of supplying ite ms like suitcases, hard-shell luggage, rucksacks, or similar goods to C APFs, KPKB, Armed Forces, or any other Government Organization. 17. Past Turnover: Past financial turnover requirements will be applicable dire ctly based on the final total published BID Value. 18. Total Delivery Period: The total delivery period for the entire consignmen t shall be strictly 120 Days from the date of issuance of the contract agreement. The vendor must ensure that all processes, including sample submission, appro val, manufacturing, pre-dispatch inspection (PDI), and final delivery, are successfully completed within this stipulated 120 days timeframe. 19. Advance Sample Submission and Approval Process: (a) The L1 vendor shall be given a maximum of 15 days from the date of t he contract agreement to submit an advance sample of the "Suitcase with Trolley" for evaluation. (b) A period of 07 days from the date of sample receipt will be allotted to the buyer side for inspection and formal approval of the advance sample. (c) This combined 22-day timeline for sample submission and approval is strictly included within the total 120-day delivery period. No separate tim e extension will be granted for this process. (d) Any delay beyond the timelines specified above, or any failure to com plete the final supply within the overall 120 days, shall be the sole respon sibility of the seller. Such delays will be subject to the absolute deduction of applicable Liquidated Damages (LD) charges as per standard procurem ent rules. 21. Bidders are bound to accept the orders accordingl

y. 28. Liquidated Damages will be applicable as per Rule 9.3.8 & 9.3.9 of Manual f or Procurement of Goods, Second Edition 2024. If the seller fails to deliver any o r all of the goods / service within the original /re-fixed delivery period specified i n the contract, the buyer will be entitled to deduct/recover the liquidated dama ges for the delay, unless covered under Force Majeure conditions aforesaid, @ 0 .5% (Half) per cent of the prices of any portion of stores delivered late, for each week or part thereof of delay. The total damages shall not exceed 10(Ten) per c ent of the value of delayed goods. 29. Bidders are advised to check applicable GST on their own before quoting. Bu yer will not take any responsibility in this regard. GST reimbursement will be as per actual or as per applicable rates (whichever is lower), subject to the maxim um of quoted GST %. 30. Fall Clause: The following fall clause will from part of the contract placed o n successful bidder: a) The price charged for the stores supplied under the contract by the seller shall, in no event, exceed the lowest prices at which the seller sells the stores or offers to sell stores of identical description to any persons/Organizati on, including the purchaser or any department of the Central government or an y Department of state government or any statutory undertaking of the central o r state government as the case may be during the period till performance of all supply orders placed during the currency of the contract is completed. b) If, at any time, during the said period the seller reduces the sale p rice, sells or offers to sell such stores to any person/organization, including the b uyer or any department of central Government or any Department of State Gov ernment or any Statutory undertaking of the central or state Government, as th e case may be, at a price lower than the price chargeable under the contract, th e bidder shall forthwith notify such reduction or sale or order of sale to the CoB RA HQ and the price payable under the contract for the stores of such reduction of sale offer of the sale shall stand correspondingly reduced. The above stipulat ion will, however, not apply to : i- Exports by the seller. ii- Sale of goods as original equipment at price lower than the price charged for normal replacement. iii- Sale of goods such as drugs which have expiry date. iv- Sale of goods at lower price on or after the date of completion of sale/placement of the order of goods by the authority concerned. c) The seller shall furnish the following certificate to the paying Authority along with each bill for payment for supplies made against the Contract- “ We certify t hat there has been no reduction in sale price of the stores of descriptio n identical to the stores supplied to the CoBRA HQ under the contract herein an d such stores have not been offered/sold by me/us to any person/organization

including the purchaser or any department of Central Government or any Depar tment of a state Government or any Statutory Undertaking of the Central or stat e Government as the case may be upto the date of bill/the date of completion of supplies against all supply orders placed during the currency of the contract at price lower than the price charged to the CoBRA HQ. 31. Turnover, experience supply orders and other bid document are liable to be v erified through the BOOs or competent authority, if found incorrect/fake, the bid der shall be blacklisted for 02 years. 33. The Seller shall not assign the Contract in whole or part to any entity. 34. Start-UP must produce valid documents with details of the investment in the plant and machinery and also corresponding details of the date of incorporation, factory license and ITR details and balance sheet to confirm that they are indee d start-up and manufacturing units. Arbitration Clause as per GeM Terms and co nditions. 35. RISK PURCHASE CLAUSE: If the successful bidder fails to supply material within the stipulated delivery date or material supplied other than specification specified in our bid, Buyer reserves the right to terminate contract for that item s, forfeiture of security deposit and at the cost liable to the seller. Any extra cos t incurred in the procurement of the material from alternative source will be rec overed from the security deposit/ bank guarantee and pending bills of existing fi rm and if the value of the materials under risk purchase exceeds the amount of security deposit / or bank guarantee and pending bills the same may be recover ed, if necessary, by due legal process. 36. FORCE MAJEURE CLAUSE:- A force majeure (FM) means extraordinary eve nts or circumstance beyond human control such as an event described as an ac t of God (like a natural calamity) or events such as a war, strike, riots, crimes, (b ut not including negligence or wrong doing, predictable /seasonal rain and any other events specifically excluded in the clause). And force majeure clause in th e contract frees both parties from contractual liability or obligation when preven ted by such events from fulfilling their obligations under the contract. An FM cla use does not excuse a party’s non-performance entirely, but only suspend it for

the duration of the FM. The firm has to give notice of FM as soon as it occurs an d it cannot be claimed ex post facto. There may be a FM situation affecting the purchase organization only. In such a situation, the purchase organization is to communicate with the supplier along similar lines as above for further necessar y action. If the performance in whole or in part or any obligation under this contr act is prevented or delayed by any reason of FM for a period exceeding 90 days, either party may at its option terminate the contract without any financial repercussion on either side. Notwithstanding the punitive provisions contained i n the contract for delay or breach of contract, the supplier would not be liable fo r imposition of any such sanction so long as the delay and/ or failure of the supp lier in fulfilling its obligations under the contracts is the result of an event cover ed in the FM clause. 37. Conflict Of Interest Among Bidders/ Agents :- A vendor shall not have c onflict of interest with other bidders. Such conflict of interest can lead to anti-co mpetitive practices to the detriment of purchaser’s interests. The bidder found t o have a conflict of interest in the bid shall be disqualified. A bidder may be con sidered to have a conflict of interest with one or more parties in this bidding process if; a. They have controlling partner (s) in common. b. They receive or have received any direct or indirect subsidy/financial st ake from any of them. c. They have the same legal representative/agent for purposes of this bid. d. They have relationship with each other, directly or through common thir d par ties, that puts them in a position to have access to information about or influence on the bid of another bidder; e. Bidder participates in more than one bid in this bidding process. Particip ation by a bidder in more than one Bid will result in the disqualification of all bid s in which the parties are involved. However, this does not limit the inclusi on of the components/ sub-assemblies from o ne bidding manufacturer in more than one bid . f. A bidder or any of its affiliates participated as a consultant in the prepara tion of the design or technical specification of the contract that is the subject of the bid. In case of a holding company having more than one independently man ufacturing units, or more than one unit having common business ownership/ma nagement, only one unit should quote. Similar restrictions would apply to closel y related sister companies. Bidders must proactively declare such sister/commo n business/management units in same/similar line of business. 38. Purchase’s Discretions: - (a) The Purchaser reserves the right to cancel the bidding process and r eject all bids at any time prior to award of contract, without incurring any liabilit y, whatsoever to the bidder/ bidders. (b) Purchaser reserves the right to get the manufacturing capacity of all
